description:
Example Manufacturing Ltd (fictional) - finance:
Revenue: EUR 1.2 million in 2015, 2.5 million in 2018, 3.1 million in 2021 and 3.5 million in 2024. Net margin: approximately 4-8%; profitable for eight years. Investments: CNC and welding robotics in 2018-2020, ERP in 2022, solar panels in 2024. Debt ratio below 40%; major investments financed by bank loans. Strong cash flow. Target: annual revenue growth of 5-10% for three years, and international sales of 15% by 2027. Risks: raw material prices and international competition.
